messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Hey Bob, I just started a new job at InnovateTech last Monday. It feels great!

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Congratulations! What role are you in?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: I'm a senior data engineer on the infrastructure team.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: That sounds exciting. Do you work remotely or in the office?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Mostly remote, but I go into the San Francisco office on Tuesdays.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Nice. I heard InnovateTech just raised a big Series B round.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Yes, 80 million dollars. My manager Emma said we're doubling the engineering team.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Are you still living in Berkeley?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Actually no — I moved to Oakland two months ago. The commute is much better.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Makes sense. How do you like Oakland so far?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: I love it. There's a farmers market near my apartment every Sunday.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: That sounds awesome. I'll have to visit sometime.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Bob, I finished the distributed caching project I mentioned last week!

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Already? That was fast. How did the review go?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Really well. Emma approved it and it's going to production next Friday.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Impressive. Are you taking any time off after that?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Yes, I'm flying to Tokyo with my partner for two weeks starting April 20th.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Tokyo in spring — that's perfect timing for cherry blossoms.

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Exactly! My partner loves Japanese food, so we're going to try lots of restaurants.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: Have you been learning any Japanese?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: Just the basics. I've been using the Duolingo app every morning since January.

messages.speaker: Bob
messages.text: That's dedication. What time does your flight leave?

messages.speaker: Alice
messages.text: 7 AM from SFO. We have a layover in Seattle.
